mainEntity.name: Is Matrix Massage & Bodywork actually in Pleasant Prairie?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Our studio is located in Salem, Wisconsin, and we welcome guests traveling from Pleasant Prairie and surrounding communities.

mainEntity.name: How long is the drive from Pleasant Prairie?

acceptedAnswer.text: It varies based on your starting address, time and road conditions. Open our directions link to view the current route to 24804 75th St in Salem.

mainEntity.name: Can I book deep tissue or Swedish massage from Pleasant Prairie?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can review available massage services online and choose the appropriate appointment at the Salem studio.

mainEntity.name: Does Matrix offer lymphatic drainage massage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Check the current massage menu for availability. If you're interested because of surgery or swelling, seek medical guidance before booking.

mainEntity.name: How do I know what my appointment costs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use our current online booking menu to see service prices and durations before you select a time.

mainEntity.name: Can I ask questions before booking?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Text Matrix Massage & Bodywork at (262) 939-9325 with your question and the service you're considering.
